prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select your companion to preview interactive playtime!"]
1: ["Your Desktop Companion Is Ready!", "Click launch to place your pet onto your desktop screen.", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]
2: ["Save Your Companion to Account", "Sign in now to lock in your custom pet and prevent loss on sign-out."]
3: ["Choose Your Companion's Journey"]
4: ["Creating Desktop Companion Physics...", "Assembling animations, desktop collisions, and AI interactions."]
5: ["Sign in with your primary account so your customized desktop pet is saved across re-logins."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Complete your certificate now to claim your free Desktop Accessory Pack!", "Bonus Starter Pack Included"]
7: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives on your desktop taskbar. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to hide, move, or talk to your pet.", "Press Ctrl+Pet or click the tray icon if your pet hides behind windows."]
8: ["Generation takes a few moments. We will send a desktop alert as soon as your companion is ready!"]
9: ["Explore Companion Avatars", "Swipe or click arrows to view available pet personalities."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus starter pack with urgency to claim.
